svg.title: On the Shoulders of Giants: the academic lineage of Saleem A. Al Dajani
svg.desc: Academic lineage recorded by the Mathematics Genealogy Project, running from Galileo Galilei (1585), Vincenzo Viviani (1642), Isaac Barrow (1652), Isaac Newton (1668), Roger Cotes (1706), Robert Smith (1715), Walter Taylor (1723), Stephen Whisson (1742), Thomas Postlethwaite (1756), Thomas Jones (1782), Adam Sedgwick (1811), William Hopkins (1830), Edward John Routh (1857), Alfred North Whitehead (1884), Arthur Stanley Eddington (1905), Max Krook (1938), Donald G. M. Anderson (1963), David E. Keyes (1984), Saleem A. Al Dajani (2024).
svg.text: My academic lineage, from Galileo and Newton to today
18 academic generations across 439 years, as recorded by the Mathematics Genealogy Project. Years are those listed in each record.
Early links reflect recorded mentorship, not modern doctoral advising.
